turnos.t: Resistance is the ability to withstand a disturbance without changing much: how little it changes during the disturbance. Whereas resilience is the ability to recover its structure and function afterwards. Use the word whereas. And complexity brings stability: functional redundancy, several species doing the same job, means losing one part doesn't collapse the whole.
Time lags. Lynx numbers keep rising for one to two years after hares peak, so both populations cycle roughly every ten years.
